chunks: Do you not see that God has created the heavens and the earth with ultimate reason? If He so wills He could take you away from the earth and raise a new creation (in your place).
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's ability to replace humanity with a new creation?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the absolute sovereignty of Allah in both creation and resurrection, highlighting that the current human existence is contingent upon His will. It serves as a profound reminder of the transient nature of humanity, reinforcing the belief in bodily resurrection and the ultimate accountability of all beings before the Divine.
